decisions.reason: As a large, established German software firm with some slack, we would likely keep a product that has remained on its own page for two years because that persistence suggests results are at least near aspiration and not yet triggering a strong reallocation of resources.

Because this gateway was only launched in 2024 and is still explicitly marketed on its own page, we would keep it while monitoring performance, using organisational slack to tolerate short-run uncertainty unless clear underperformance emerges.

We would keep this newly launched adjacent gateway for now, but its somewhat niche nature and limited track record make it slightly more exposed to problemistic search and resource redeployment if early results fall below aspiration.
